name: 同花顺iFinD金融数据查询
description_zh: 同花顺iFinD金融数据查询，查询股票、基金、宏观经济、行业经济、新闻公告、债券、港美股及指数板块数据；其中A股、基金、债券、指数支持日内高频/实时行情数据，同时支持智能选股、选基、宏观行业经济指标搜索、金融公告资讯搜索等服务。
description_en: THS iFinD Financial Data Query: Access comprehensive data on stocks, funds, macroeconomic and industry indicators, news & announcements, bonds, Hong Kong & U.S. equities, and index sectors. Notably, A-shares, funds, bonds, and indices are supported with intraday high-frequency and real-time market data. The platform also offers a suite of intelligent services, including smart stock screening, fund selection, macro & industry indicator search, and financial news & announcement search.
